panels.title: Inputs & Commodities
panels.subtitle: Traded proxies for what you build with, move, and burn

tiles.label: HRC steel futures
tiles.note: US Midwest hot-rolled coil, USD per short ton. A daily steel signal - NOT your delivered Australian rebar or structural steel price, which is set by supply contracts and local fabricator margins.

tiles.label: Global steel producers
tiles.note: Global steel producer equities - the margin side of the steel price.

tiles.label: Diesel (ULSD)
tiles.note: NY Harbor ULSD, USD per gallon - the global diesel benchmark. Plant, haulage and generators all price off this.

tiles.label: European gas (TTF)
tiles.note: European gas benchmark. Sets the marginal energy cost for cement, glass and brick.

tiles.label: Dry bulk freight
tiles.note: Dry bulk freight futures. This is the cost of shipping iron ore, coal, cement and aggregates - the bulk side of your input chain.

tiles.label: A.P. Moller-Maersk
tiles.note: Container liner bellwether. Carried because the actual container indices (Drewry WCI, Freightos FBX) are proprietary and not freely redistributable - liner equities are the free daily read on container rates.

tiles.label: ZIM Integrated Shipping
tiles.note: Near pure-play spot container carrier, so it tracks container freight rates closely.

panels.title: Thematic & Cycle
panels.subtitle: Where capital is going. Read these for direction over months, not for today's move.

tiles.label: US home construction
tiles.note: US housing cycle tends to lead the Australian one. Watch for turns, not levels.

tiles.label: US infrastructure
tiles.note: US infrastructure spend - a read on global demand for cement, steel and aggregates.

tiles.label: Global infrastructure
tiles.note: Global listed infrastructure - long-duration assets, so highly rate-sensitive.

tiles.label: Copper miners
tiles.note: Copper miners. Copper leads the industrial cycle more reliably than most indicators.
